scripts.db:setup: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && prisma db push && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.verify: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && DATABASE_URL=file:./verify.db prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL=file:./verify.db tsx scripts/verify.ts
scripts.cf:build: node scripts/patch-opennext-preview-props.mjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-d1.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.cf:preview: node scripts/patch-opennext-preview-props.mjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-d1.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.cf:deploy: node scripts/patch-opennext-preview-props.mjs && node scripts/patch-prisma-d1.mjs && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.cf:schema: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script --output prisma/d1/migrations/0001_init.sql
